purpose: Teach: 存分/思いつか/おそらくは/久し振り/こんばんわ/すっごい/言い聞かせ/戸惑い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お休みは存分に休んでね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, make sure you really rest on your days off, okay?
lines.style: Warm, gentle instruction. Soft opening. Maternal concern without pressure. Slight lift at the end — reassurance more than directive.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、何を出すか思いつかないよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm drawing a blank on what the new menu item should be, honestly.
lines.style: Light frustration wrapped in wry humor. Self-deprecating laugh beneath the surface. Pace stays easy — she's venting to someone safe, not looking for answers.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様はおそらくは常連さんね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customers who come in are probably regulars, aren't they?
lines.style: Gentle observation. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Quiet certainty — not questioning, but inviting Aoi to notice what she already knows.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、久し振りにお見えになったわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That regular came by for the first time in ages the other day.
lines.style: Pleased surprise in the voice. Slight warmth on remembering. Light pace. The satisfaction of a small, noticed thing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様に「こんばんわ」って迎えようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's greet them with a real 'good evening' when they come in, okay?
lines.style: Gentle direction. Not bossy — collaborative. A suggestion wrapped in warmth. Slight pause before the greeting, like she's showing by example.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の感想、すっごい嬉しかったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Their feedback really made my day, you know?
lines.style: Genuine pleasure breaking through. Slightly breathless — she's still glowing from the comment. Warm, uncomplicated joy. No performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、自分に「丁寧にね」と言い聞かせるわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I keep reminding myself to be more thoughtful about it.
lines.style: Quiet self-reflection. A little harder on herself than necessary. Steady, like she's spoken this to herself before. No seeking reassurance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新人さんに戸惑いがあったかもね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new barista might have been a bit uncertain earlier.
lines.style: Gentle, tentative observation. Soft opening. Not criticism — noticing with care. Trailing thought, like she's still working through what she saw.
